keySentence: The jungle operates by its own ancient and absolute law.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Baloo was a big brown bear and Mowgli's teacher. He taught Mowgli the Law of the Jungle word by word. The Law covered every situation an animal might face. It covered hunting and water rights and how to greet others. Breaking the Law brought real punishment from the jungle. Baloo said the Law was older than any animal alive. The jungle operates by its own ancient and absolute law.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Baloo the brown bear was Mowgli's most patient and most dedicated teacher in the jungle. He taught Mowgli the Law of the Jungle word by word and lesson by lesson each day. The Law covered every situation that an animal in the jungle might ever face. It governed hunting and mating seasons and the rights of every creature at the waterhole. Breaking the Law brought serious consequences from the entire jungle community together. Baloo told Mowgli that the Law was older than any animal alive and wiser than any single mind. No wolf or tiger or elephant had written it but all of them lived by it without question. The jungle operates by its own ancient and absolute law.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Of all the creatures in the Indian jungle, Baloo the brown bear was the most patient and most dedicated teacher. It was his self-appointed task to drill the Law of the Jungle into every cub of the wolf pack, Mowgli included. The Law covered an astonishing range of situations — hunting protocols, the sanctity of the waterhole, the treatment of strangers, the timing of mating seasons. Baloo made Mowgli repeat every article of it until the words came faster than the boy's own breathing did. What impressed Mowgli most was not the content of the Law itself but its extraordinary age and its absolute universality across all species. No animal alive had written a single word of it, and yet every animal alive obeyed it with a discipline that humans would have envied in any courtroom. Baloo explained that the Law had been refined over countless generations by the accumulated wisdom of the jungle itself. It was older than the oldest elephant and more reliable than the change of seasons that kept the jungle breathing. The jungle operates by its own ancient and absolute law.
